title: Skydive Vancouver
gap: Price for tandem skydiving not stated
blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving with experienced instructors for a thrilling free fall adventure. They also offer an Accelerated Freefall Program for those who want to learn to skydive solo. The drop zone is located about 45 minutes east of Downtown Vancouver in Abbotsford.
extraNote: Abbotsford Skydive Centre, 5112 Gladwin Rd, Abbotsford, BC
